newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Low confidence hitting NZ's 97/98 forecasts-Peters.
newsitem.headline: Low confidence hitting NZ's 97/98 forecasts-Peters.

text.p: New Zealand's Treasurer and Deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters, due to deliver his first budget in three weeks, said on Thursday that low business confidence had led to 1997/98 growth forecasts being cut.
He gave no specific details, but said that the government believed the GDP growth rate had bottomed at above 2.0 percent in the current cycle.

"The lower business confidence means that Treasury's (growth) forecasts for the coming year will be revised down and that has a significant effect on taxes," he told a business audience in a lunchtime address.
